catalog.name: Demographics and Populated Places
catalog.description: Global populated places and demographic datasets providing context for water resource management, population distribution analysis, and socio-economic studies related to water access and security.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: World Cities data from ArcGIS Hub. Original data sources may include Natural Earth, OpenStreetMap, and various national statistical offices.

info.name: License
info.content: Data generally available under open data licenses. Please verify specific licensing terms for each dataset and cite appropriately.

info.name: Applications
info.content: Water access analysis, urban hydrology, population-based water demand estimation, and emergency response planning.

members.name: World Cities
members.description:
Global dataset of populated places including cities, towns, and settlements with population and geographic information.

Dataset URL: https://hub.arcgis.com/datasets/6996f03a1b364dbab4008d99380370ed_0

info.name: Background
info.content: This comprehensive global dataset contains information about populated places worldwide, including cities, towns, and other settlements. It provides essential demographic and geographic context for water resource planning and analysis.

info.name: Data Content
info.content: Includes settlement names, coordinates, population estimates, administrative information, and classification by settlement type and size.

info.name: Coverage
info.content: Global coverage with thousands of populated places, from major metropolitan areas to smaller towns and settlements.

info.name: Update Frequency
info.content: Periodically updated based on available census data, surveys, and administrative records from various countries.

info.name: Applications
info.content: Urban water supply planning, population-based water demand analysis, settlement pattern studies, emergency response planning, and socio-economic analysis of water access.

info.name: Data Quality
info.content: Population estimates and boundaries may vary in accuracy depending on the source country's data collection methods and update frequency.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: World Cities dataset from ArcGIS Hub. Compiled from multiple sources including Natural Earth, OpenStreetMap, and national statistical offices.
